# Snake UI

Snake UI is a Vue 3 component library for uni-app commerce and CMS applications. It targets H5, mini programs, and App. Library source is in `src/uni_modules/snake-ui/`; VitePress documentation is in `docs/`.

## Using this repository

- Public package: `@puresnake/snake-ui`
- Recommended component registration: uni-app easycom, using `snake-*` tags
- Manual component import: `@puresnake/snake-ui/components/snake-<name>/snake-<name>.vue`
- Runtime, utilities, and adapters: `@puresnake/snake-ui/libs`
- Theme entry: `@puresnake/snake-ui/theme.scss`
- Source, TypeScript types, and matching docs are the authoritative API. Do not infer Snake UI APIs from uView Pro without verification.

- Installation and registration: `docs/components/install.md`

## Critical behavior notes

- `snake-tabbar` hides the native tabBar by default when mounted on a native tabBar page. Set `hide-tab-bar="false"` only when the native bar should remain visible.
- `snake-icon` uses `sicon-*` class names backed by the Base64 font in `src/uni_modules/snake-ui/iconfont.css`; no standalone font file is required.
- CMS services, requests, cache, and host configuration are injected through the Snake UI plugin. Do not hard-code business endpoints in library components.
- For platform-specific behavior, inspect source conditionals and test on the target platform; a successful H5 run does not prove mini-program or App behavior.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm type-check
pnpm test:component-contracts
pnpm test:runtime
pnpm test:cms
pnpm test:component-docs
pnpm docs:build
```
